g.text: Generation time and later-search cost | All five modes
Complete generation time | P = 1024, all 1024 cases | Logarithmic time axes | Lower is faster
Top: common 16-generation runs. Bottom: seed 0 only, using extended runs where available; each line ends at its last measured generation.
